label: О ней
description: Prepositional sentences that train 'about her' after о/обо in real conversation.

missions.phrase: На работе все говорят о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Being discussed. 'О ней' is the prepositional form of она after the preposition о, marking her as the topic. The plural 'говорят' reads as an impersonal 'people are talking'.

missions.phrase: Интересно, что они думают о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Others' opinion. 'О ней' is the topic of their thoughts, in the prepositional case after о. The embedded clause shows the construction inside reported thought.

missions.phrase: Я весь день думаю о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Mental focus. 'Думать' takes о plus the prepositional case, so она becomes 'ней'. 'Весь день' is an everyday time phrase that leaves the pronoun untouched.

missions.phrase: Он написал красивую песню о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a work. Here 'о ней' modifies the noun 'песню', naming what the song is about. Prepositional complements with о attach to nouns as well as verbs.

missions.phrase: Скоро выйдет книга о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Subject matter. 'О ней' tells us what the book covers, staying prepositional after о. The construction is the standard way to name a work's subject.

missions.phrase: Друзья часто спрашивают о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite inquiry. 'Спрашивать о ком-то' uses о plus the prepositional case, so она appears as 'ней'. This is how you say people ask after someone.

missions.phrase: Здесь о ней никто ничего не знает.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negative frame. Even under the double negation 'никто ничего не знает', 'о ней' keeps its prepositional form. Multiple negatives are normal and obligatory in Russian.

missions.phrase: В классе все думают о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Broad subject. 'Все' is a sweeping plural subject, while 'о ней' stays the fixed prepositional object of думать. The locative 'в классе' just sets the scene.

missions.phrase: Мама очень заботится о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Care for someone. The verb 'заботиться' governs о plus the prepositional case, so она becomes 'ней'. This is a warm, common everyday pattern.

missions.phrase: Они уже всем рассказали о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past reporting. 'Рассказать о ком-то' keeps о plus the prepositional 'ней'. The past 'рассказали' and dative 'всем' surround the pronoun without changing its case.

missions.phrase: В прошлом году сняли фильм о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a film. 'О ней' names what the film is about and modifies the noun 'фильм'. The construction holds for any kind of work.

missions.phrase: В журнале вышла большая статья о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Written about her. 'О ней' is the prepositional complement of 'статья', naming its subject. Such phrases fill titles, bios, and the press.

missions.phrase: Они знают о ней слишком много.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Object of knowledge. 'Знать о ком-то' takes о plus the prepositional 'ней'. 'Слишком много' adds an everyday evaluation while the pronoun stays fixed.

missions.phrase: В семье мало говорят о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Quantity of talk. 'О ней' is the topic of 'говорят', held prepositional by о. The quantifier 'мало' measures how much, not the pronoun's case.

missions.phrase: В деревне хорошо говорят о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Positive judgment. 'О ней' stays prepositional after о, while 'хорошо' colours how people speak. A natural way to report a good reputation.

missions.phrase: Мне интересно, что говорят о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative reaction plus reported speech. 'Мне интересно' frames the feeling with a dative experiencer, and 'что говорят о ней' carries the prepositional pronoun. Two structures combine cleanly.

missions.phrase: Я хорошо помню, что говорили о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Memory of speech. The verb 'помню' opens a clause where 'о ней' stays prepositional after о. Past 'говорили' is an impersonal plural.

missions.phrase: У меня есть вопросы о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Noun complement. 'О ней' modifies the noun 'вопросы', naming their subject. The existential 'у меня есть' gives a natural everyday frame.

missions.phrase: Коллеги весь день спорят о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dispute over a topic. 'Спорить о ком-то' takes о plus the prepositional case, so она becomes 'ней'. The plural 'спорят' makes it sound like real office life.

missions.phrase: Я не хочу больше говорить о ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Refusal to discuss. 'О ней' stays prepositional after о despite the verb chain 'не хочу говорить'. This negated-verb-plus-infinitive stacking is very common in speech.
